title: Console Rapid Onboarding: Snapflow checklist & context-aware empty states
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Ship a compact, developer-friendly first-run flow ("Snapflow") that surfaces a minimal checklist, context-aware empty states, and inline tips to reduce time-to-first-success for engineers integrating Redwood. This ticket contains the visual asset inventory, copy variants, and annotated screenshots for handoff to engineering and docs.
acceptance_criteria: Figma artboard with Snapflow micro-interactions (desktop + tablet) reviewed and approved by PM
Three empty-state variants produced: Demo data, Private deployment hint, Dedicated capacity upsell
Copy A/B variants written and peer-reviewed with final selections recorded
Annotated assets exported: PNGs (2x), SVG icons, and a sprite for in-console use
Design tokens and spacing/update notes added to the style token doc (Confluence) for engineers
Handoff package includes performance-conscious image sizes and suggested Lottie fallback
review_comments: 2026-01-08 - PM: 'Prefer reducing steps to 3 for 80% of new users; keep advanced tasks behind a 'power-user' link.' - Elena Martinez
2026-01-20 - Eng: 'KV cache hint references runtime metrics. Add link to APM trace in tooltip.' - Dev: Samir Rao
2026-02-02 - Security: 'Ensure onboarding hints do not expose internal telemetry links for private deployments.' - Tessa O'Neil
2026-02-18 - Design review: 'Swap illustration set B for neutral palette for enterprise customers.' - Marco Chen
2026-03-04 - UX Research: 'Prototype test: 72% task completion in unmoderated test (n=28) with Snapflow vs 54% baseline. Users preferred inline command snippets.' - Priya Nair
links: GH issue for empty state tracking: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/issues/4578
notes: Implementation considerations: prefer CSS sprite for icons to reduce runtime requests; provide fallback text-only empty state for low-bandwidth/private deployments. Use Lottie for the progress check animation but include a static PNG fallback for on-prem air-gapped installs. Copy variants are stored in the Figma file under /copy/variants.
handoff_steps: Export artboards at 2x and optimize with svgo/pngquant
Create a single feature-flagged component (OnboardSnapflow) with slots for 1) checklist, 2) empty state, 3) tips
Document Lottie fallback and aria-labels for accessibility
implementation_risks: Heavy animation may increase first-paint on very low-end CPUs
Copy misalignment with i18n expansion — plan for longer strings
Enterprise customers may require removal of any outbound product links in private deployments
next_steps: Finalize A copy as default and schedule a handoff sync with ENG (30m) week of 2026-03-15. Tag PM to confirm priority gating for dedicated upsell flow. Prepare a quick video walkthrough for the release notes.
audit_trail: 2025-11-12: Ticket created by Aisha (initial brief). 2026-01-10: First pass designs uploaded. 2026-02-03: Internal usability test run (remote unmoderated). 2026-03-02: Design sign-off pending token export. 2026-03-10: Assets packaged and PR opened.
